capture.description: Opt-in session capture onto the bound task's discussion in the shared board. The hook does nothing unless enabled here, registered only at project scope, and a task is bound.

taskboard.description: This project's table in the shared Anytype task board channel. Without link the table is private to Anytype.

workers.description: Allowed agent plugins, in preference order: built-in (integrations/plugins/builtin) or the project's own (.mstack/plugins). argv hosts are spawned; handoff hosts get a launch spec.

link.description: External issue tracker. mode pull/push is a partial link; scope label limits it to labelled issues/tasks.

team.description: Linear team key this project's issues live in (pull filter and push target).

workspace.description: Linear workspace URL key (linear.app/<key>); the key must belong to it or sync refuses.

key_entry.description: Which row of the owner's .secrets/linear.csv the project key came from (traceability only).

auto.description: Let `mstack board tick/watch` act on this table unattended: apply verdicts and dispatch approved tasks.

apps.description: Apps in this repo, by short code (title prefix [CODE]). A worker for an app's task starts in its folder; the worktree is still the whole repo.

link.description: This app's own Linear link; its issues are filed as [CODE] tasks and only its tasks are pushed.

team.description: Linear team key this project's issues live in (pull filter and push target).

workspace.description: Linear workspace URL key (linear.app/<key>); the key must belong to it or sync refuses.

key_entry.description: Which row of the owner's .secrets/linear.csv the project key came from (traceability only).

repos.description: Multi-repo workspace: the project root is a folder of git repos. Each task gets a folder under .mstack/worktrees/<issue>/ with one worktree per repo it changes.

path.description: repo folder relative to the project root

base.description: branch new task branches start from (default: origin/HEAD)

role.description: what the repo is, for briefs

docs_url.description: Base URL for the repo's docs (e.g. https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>/blob/main/). Linear issues link to docs under it instead of carrying long text.

private.description: Linear boards: never write to Linear (no comments, status changes or new issues). The orchestrator's messages go to .mstack/journal.json and the owner's verdicts come through `mstack board owner`.

backend.description: linear: the board is the owner's own Linear issues (assigned to or created by them) in the configured link teams; no mirror.

orchestrators.description: Named orchestrator scopes within one repo: which links (apps; "*" = the table-wide link) and which root issues (focus, sub-issues included) each orchestrator works on.

exclude.description: Root issues (with their sub-issues) this scope leaves to another scope, e.g. a sub-orchestrator focused on them.

never_done.description: MST-60: mstack never sets Linear Done here; the consumer (product owner, iOS) closes the issue. Landed work stays In Progress, live on Preview (merged --verify) is In Review.

landing.description: MST-60: the integration branch work lands on (e.g. clientapp-dev-sb); `board merged` checks origin/<landing> instead of main.

linear_status.description: MST-60: board phase → Linear status name overrides (null leaves Linear as it is). Private boards default to Todo/In Progress/In Review → In Progress.

never_done.description: MST-60: mstack never sets Linear Done here; the consumer (product owner, iOS) closes the issue. Landed work stays In Progress, live on Preview (merged --verify) is In Review.

landing.description: MST-60: the integration branch work lands on (e.g. clientapp-dev-sb); `board merged` checks origin/<landing> instead of main.

linear_status.description: MST-60: board phase → Linear status name overrides (null leaves Linear as it is). Private boards default to Todo/In Progress/In Review → In Progress.

joints.description: Plugins for the non-agent joints (see integrations/plugins). Agents come from taskboard.workers, the link from taskboard.link.

hub.description: mstack's own config only: where the board keeps its state, private journals and the event queue (docs/design/011-EVENT-HUB.md).

store.description: file: .mstack/evidence JSON and each project's .mstack/journal.json. postgres: mstack_orchestrator (apply `mstack events schema --apply` first); the JSON files stay as the fallback.

resend_minutes.description: `mstack events next` resends events still `sent` after this many minutes.

status_table.description: The owner's read-only "My tasks" table in Anytype, fed from the hub every few minutes (docs/design/014-STATUS-TABLE.md). false switches the hub step and `mstack status-table sync` off.
